scope: Conversation-list transient read/empty-state recovery with existing merge admission, re-entry and project regressions

node_regression.evidence: Actual transpiled components/hooks/callbacks, installed React static markup and subscribed QueryObserver/cache/refetch transitions. Scheduling, transport, seeded selection, storage and unrelated children are explicit doubles; not actual React lifecycle, browser focus, layout or performance acceptance.

first_repaired_run.correction: The harness counted constructed but unused Retry JSX. It now records only the actual React-rendered Retry component; no assertions removed. The earlier observer-subscription correction remains recorded separately in baseline.json.

previous_api_verification.basis: Seven API implementation/test hashes match the earlier checkpoint; no backend edit in this batch.

browser_discovery.command: corepack pnpm --filter web exec playwright test e2e/ux-recovery-followup.spec.ts --list --output <task-temp>/list-recovery-discovery
intended_assertions: Active/archived list at 375px Chinese/light and 1440px English/dark retains actual reading node and focus after injected 503.
A real browser offline/online transition requests stale refetch; injected 503 does not establish a real network outage.
Selection remains checked through held read-only Retry; recovery performs no conversation writes and preserves synthetic messages/status.
Two empty-active/existence-error cases retry only the secondary read and use a real synthetic archived row and Archive destination.
Empty active/existence reads are explicit doubles, not database-emptiness claims; screenshots were not generated.

implementation.retained_read: Current-mode cached rows/selection survive transient failure with localized stale notice; no second cache.
implementation.no_cached_read: Initial or empty-cache failure remains an explicit retryable error.
implementation.access: HTTP 401/403/404 hides cached rows/bulk controls; sort placeholders only accept the same list mode.
implementation.empty: First-run import retained after successful empty existence read. Other active-empty states name no active conversations and link to Archive; failed secondary read is explicit and retries only itself.
implementation.unchanged: Existing mutations, backend, merged request owner, Undo owner, cache freshness policy, tokens and dependencies.
implementation.limitation: A new sort key's final error may have no cached rows.
implementation.merge_wording_correction: Prior no-HTTP shorthand refers to automatic merge lookup/POST. Opening the dialog may still run its existing account-capabilities GET.
